purpose: Stress the frozen generic morphology score against an ordinary-geology adversary before allowing it to rank FKt230303 bathymetry.

components: five-small-pinnacle positive cluster centered near pixel 112,112
strong parallel fault/graben/scarp family spanning approximately x=275..345
synthetic_fixture.boundary: Synthetic terrain is engine QA, not an estimate of real vent prevalence or FKt230303 performance.

frozen_v1_score.orientation_anisotropy_usage: reported as confounder flag only; no penalty in v1.0

TOPA_interpretation: This is a useful failure. A generic roughness/relief detector mistakes coherent fault-scarp geometry for the strongest morphology candidate. Real Puy des Folles contains exactly this kind of fault/graben terrain, so v1.0 is not authorized for field ranking.
lesson: A detector can be sensitive to structure while being specific to the wrong structure. Regularity and large relief are not vent evidence; geological lineation must be modeled explicitly as an adversarial family.

required_repair.name: LINEATION_CONFOUNDER_PENALTY_V1_1
required_repair.rule: Penalize unusually high orientation anisotropy in the candidate score while preserving the tile as a reported geological confounder rather than deleting it.
